ideas.pitch: A lightweight, offline-first progressive web app for campus navigation at GEC Challakere, utilizing local Wi-Fi triangulation and pre-cached topological vectors.
ideas.title: CampusNav: Offline Rural College Map and Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, hyper-local logistical pain point for a rural campus setting where cellular connectivity can be spotty, appealing directly to college authorities and judges.

ideas.pitch: A localized web tool that provides instant agricultural market rates and fertilizer schedules based on voice queries spoken in regional dialects.
ideas.title: AgriYield local: Kannada Voice-Enabled Crop Advisory Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear socio-economic benefit for the surrounding agricultural community of Challakere rural region, making its real-world impact instantly relatable to judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-cost asset tracker using dynamic QR codes pasted on laboratory instruments to monitor student issuance, return status, and maintenance needs.
ideas.title: LabEquip Track: QR-Based Smart Inventory Management for College Labs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an administrative tool that GEC Challakere department heads can immediately deploy post-hackathon to solve an actual operational bottleneck.

ideas.pitch: An Arduino and Python-simulated bin monitoring dashboard that alerts campus housekeeping staff when organic versus plastic bins reach capacity thresholds.
ideas.title: SmartBin GEC: Automated Waste Segregation Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware prototyping concepts with a clean software dashboard, mirroring successful environmental IoT projects from similar regional hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A secure web portal that records student attendance inside college lecture halls by verifying local router subnet footprints to eliminate proxy attendance.
ideas.title: AttendEase: Geofenced Wi-Fi Attendance Logger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a fully functional MVP within the tight 8-hour window that solves a daily administrative annoyance for professors.
